tcp.source: FK of logged joints vs logged O_T_EE; hand offset from this recording's static BA
tcp.hand_offset_note: Physical hand (and fingers, and the wrist camera mount) sits this far along the hand z axis from where base.xml puts it: both static cameras see the finger pads 21.7 mm closer to the flange than base.xml (F/T stack 48.9 mm, not 70.6; the REASSEMBLE URDF stack is 44.5 mm). The logged O_T_EE (0.174 m from the flange) therefore lies about 22 mm beyond the pad centres. base.xml is unchanged (replay builds on it); renders apply it with view.set_hand_offset(calib_hand_offset(rec)). Proposed fix: FT_STACK = 0.0706 + hand_offset_m in build_base.py, with the tcp site moved by -hand_offset_m so it stays on O_T_EE.

board_contact.note: Only 3 parts (skill minimum 5): round pegs 1-2 give parallel pad lines; leave-one-part-out across pads 2.44 mm (mocap 3.40 mm).
